business_problem: Southern California Edison needs to maintain grid reliability as electricity demand rises from electric vehicles, buildings, and data centers, while operating across a large service area where accurate data and safe use of AI are critical.
solution_summary: Southern California Edison described an operational AI program that combines Microsoft Copilot, GPT-based capabilities, predictive analytics, and forecasting models to support both grid operations and customer-facing work. The utility first focuses on data readiness across its 50,000-square-mile footprint so AI and ML models have the right inputs. A new communications infrastructure is being rolled out to bring in real-time operational information from the grid, which then feeds forecasting use cases such as electric-vehicle penetration, grid demand, and broader grid forecasting. On the serving side, SCE is using AI in the call center to help energy advisors and is building a robust knowledge base intended to support a more autonomous conversational chat experience over time. The source does not name a storage platform, but it clearly shows an architecture pattern of real-time ingest, model-driven forecasting, and advisor-facing assistance with governance attention around AI guardrails and information protection.

solution_components.name: Microsoft Copilot
solution_components.role: Used by SCE as part of its current AI tooling to support operational work and experimentation.

solution_components.name: GPT
solution_components.role: Used within SCE's AI capabilities alongside forecasting and call-center support use cases.

data_flow: Grid and demand data gathered across SCE's territory, along with real-time information from a new communications infrastructure, is used to feed forecasting and predictive analytics capabilities. The resulting AI outputs support grid forecasting, demand planning, and call-center advisor assistance, with a knowledge base intended to power a more autonomous conversational chat experience.
business_outcome: SCE says it is enhancing grid operations with predictive analytics and AI, helping call center energy advisors today while aiming to use real-time data and forecasting to detect outages earlier, anticipate demand, and prevent disruptions more proactively.
architecture_clues: SCE is rolling out a new communications infrastructure for real-time grid information.

AI use cases mentioned include EV-penetration forecasting, grid forecasting, demand forecasting, and call-center assistance.
